messages:
Sophie L: Quick sync  spotted a few invoke examples that still reference old helper names and one structured-output snippet that returns an envelope. We should patch links, add a tiny unbox helper, and include a short migration note.

Max D: Can you list the pages? I can bundle fixes into one PR.

Sophie L: Found them: /docs/guides/invoke/quickstart, /docs/reference/structured-output.md, and one example app link pointing to a deleted branch.

Elaine R: I'll add a docs-only helper: `const unbox = v => v?.result ?? v` and a TS example for validation. Mark it clearly as temporary.

Max D: I'll open a PR that: fixes links, adds the unbox helper, shows both raw/enveloped schema examples, and a one-line migration checklist.

redwood-docs-bot: Draft PR created: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1720 lint:queued, link-check:running

Sophie L: Add a test to examples harness that runs `unbox` before AJV validation so we catch regressions.

Elaine R: Added test and changelog entry in the PR. Also included a TODO comment: "// TODO: remove helper after snippets migrated (tracking #1750)".

Max D: CI green. Merged. I'll follow up in #eng-devex about removal timeline.

Sophie L: Thanks team, will close the follow-up tracking issue after sweep.
